Subject: Discovery recap: observability + evals — next steps and commitment checklist

Hi Alex / Priya,

Thanks again for the time today — this note summarizes what we heard, success criteria, and proposed next steps so everyone is aligned. Quick TL;DR up front: FinSight is most concerned about production regressions and being able to trace quality drops back to model + prompt changes; you want dashboards, tracing hooks, golden prompt sets, and regression alerting before a staged rollout.

Key pain points (as we heard):
- Silent regressions in production when model/temperature/stop changes are pushed by MLOps.
- Lack of per-customer degradation metrics (hard to see which tenant is affected).
- Long remediation time: investigations require local replays and are slow.
- No standard golden prompt set or automated evals tied to deployments.

Current stack and constraints:
- Inference: internal hosted cluster on GCP (K80 + A100 mix), currently using a homegrown proxy in front of model endpoints.
- Observability: Prometheus + Grafana for infra metrics; no standardized app-level tracing for LLM-level signals.
- SLOs: 95th latency target ~ 350ms; cost sensitivity for embeddings-heavy features.

Success criteria (deployment gating):
1) Regression detection: automated alerts for drops in golden-prompt pass rates and sudden shift in top-k token distributions within 30 minutes.
2) Traceability: span-level traces tying user request -> prompt version -> model variant -> inference node.
3) Per-tenant degradation: dashboards showing request-level quality by customer/tenant.
4) Low-friction evals: ability to run batch evals on canary and baseline with synthetic + production-sampled prompts.

Requested observability & eval features (prioritized):
- Dashboards: operator view (latency/cost/throughput), quality view (golden prompt pass rate, QA-check failure rate), tenant heatmap.
- Tracing hooks: short header-based tracing that surfaces prompt id, prompt hash, model commit id, and rollout id.
- Golden prompt set: initial set of ~200 prompts (we suggested grouping by intent), plus tooling to version and compare.
- Regression alerts: threshold + drift detectors (statistical tests on token distributions + pass-rate thresholds).
- Rollout guardrails: auto-fallback to baseline when pass rate drops > 7% over a 15-minute window or latency > SLO.

Attachments: I attached an initial observability_requirements.xlsx with the dashboard wireframes and a starter golden_prompts_v1.txt containing 40 candidate prompts we captured in the session.

Proposed next steps (please confirm timelines):
1) FinSight to share a sample set of 2 weeks of anonymized request logs and tenant mappings — target by Fri 12/04. (Alex)
2) Redwood to produce an ops-level demo (Grafana + traces + eval report) using a synthetic replay of the logs — target by Wed 12/09. (Marcus / Dev)
3) Joint walkthrough of the demo and decision on rollout thresholds and alerting policy — target week of 12/14. (All)
4) Scope pricing for Dedicated vs Hosted runway for the pilot (estimated Q1 2027 pilot) — Vanessa to share proposal after demo.

Open questions we captured:
- Will any parts of the logs contain PII that require redaction beyond tenant ids? (Priya)
- What is your expected max tail-latency during peak for embeddings-heavy workloads? (Dev)
- Any existing golden prompts or eval harness we should incorporate? (Alex said no formal set beyond ad-hoc tests)

Thanks — looping in Marcus and Dev who will build the demo environment and run the replay. Marcus / Dev: see Alex's note below for the sample format and some answers on infra.

Best,
